subject: Request: Neoterix trial window + credit uplift approval
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@neoterix.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@neoterix.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — additional credits & trial extension for Neoterix POC

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Neoterix is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the ability to host private deployments. We've hit an internal delay on the integration side: the feature team needs an extra 6 weeks to complete the data transformer that makes our prompts deterministic across our pipelines.

We're currently at the end of our standard 30-day sandbox and have burned ~140k tokens in evaluation. To complete a meaningful end-to-end test we estimate needing an additional 200k tokens and a 45-day window beyond the standard extension.

Given that this is a strategic use case for us (regulated healthcare pilot, likely to convert to a Dedicated procurement in Q4), can Redwood make an exception and grant: 1) a 45-day extension to the sandbox window, and 2) a one-time 200k token credit (sandbox usage)?

I've attached our PO draft that the procurement team can sign once terms are agreed. If helpful, Tom from engineering can join a quick call to walk through the integration blocker.

Appreciate any help to keep the POC momentum.

Best,
Asha Menon
Head of Partnerships, Neoterix AI
Asha | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: neoterix_poc_po_draft.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@neoterix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — additional credits & trial extension for Neoterix POC

Hi Asha — thanks for the context and for sharing the PO.

We can absolutely work to keep momentum. I'm looping in Marissa (Deal Desk) and Hannah (CS lead) to surface the request formally. Quick answers up front: we typically only allow a single 30-day extension at the PLG level, and token credits outside the trial are evaluated case-by-case.

Marissa — can you assess whether a 45-day window + 200k tokens is feasible as a one-time exception? If it needs exec signoff, please escalate and include an estimated ARR/risk write-up. Hannah, can CS provide a short onboarding plan so Neoterix can finish integration in the extended window?

Asha / Tom — once we have a yes, we'll send a conditional MOU and a one-time coupon code to apply to the sandbox. Could you share a primary contact for billing/procurement and confirm the timeline that the extra 45 days would need to cover?

Talk soon,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request — additional credits & trial extension for Neoterix POC

Aditya / Sean — forwarding Neoterix's ask. Summary: customer asks for +45 days (one-time) and 200k token sandbox credit. Background:
- Current PLG limits: single 30-day extension, up to 100k tokens for targeted customers.
- Neoterix: healthcare analytics startup; pilot could convert to Dedicated (estimated $180k ARR first 12 months).
- Usage: 140k tokens consumed, estimate additional 200k to validate end-to-end run (4 workflows).

Options considered: 
A) Deny — risk of losing momentum, likely to stall and revert to competitor.
B) Approve limited uplift — offer 45-day extension + 150k tokens now; require PO or signed MOU by end of extension and a commitment to a paid pilot conversation.
C) Approve full ask — 45-day extension + 200k tokens and a discounted introductory committed pilot rate if they convert within 90 days.

Financial impact (approx): 200k token uplift = ~$2,000 in variable cost; potential upside far exceeds cost if Pilot converts. I recommend Option B as a conservative middle ground, or C if you want to move faster.

Requesting exec signoff for Option B or C. If approved we'll: 1) create a one-time coupon, 2) issue a conditional MOU (attached draft), 3) schedule Hannah for onboarding and a weekly sync with Tom.

Attachments: mou_neoterix_redwood_draft.docx

—Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request — additional credits & trial extension for Neoterix POC

Thanks for the concise summary, Marissa. Approve Option C with guardrails.

Approval details:
- One-time 45-day extension to the sandbox window (starts on current sandbox expiry date).
- One-time 200k token credit to be applied to the sandbox account.
- Condition: Neoterix must sign the attached MOU (electronic signature acceptable) within the 45-day extension or credits will be rescinded.
- Condition: If Neoterix converts to a paid Dedicated or Dedicated-proxy contract within 90 days of conversion, apply a 10% introductory discount to the first 12 months (subject to normal procurement/legal review).
- Finance note: Sean, please treat this as a marketing/sales promotion charge; estimate impact at ~$2k variable spend. No additional discount to list pricing without separate approval.

Marissa — please create coupon and MOU workflow. Dylan / Hannah — coordinate onboarding and weekly check-ins. Keep me posted if there are friction points with procurement.

—Aditya
CEO, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@neoterix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — additional credits & trial extension for Neoterix POC

Hi Asha — good news: leadership has approved your request with conditions. Below is what we can offer and the next steps.

What we've approved:
- A one-time 45-day extension to your existing sandbox (effective from your current expiry date).
- A one-time 200k token credit applied to the sandbox account.

Conditions:
1) Sign the enclosed MOU (DocuSign link below) within the 45-day extension window; credits may be revoked if the MOU is not signed.
2) If you convert to a paid Dedicated contract within 90 days of completing the POC, we'll apply a 10% introductory discount to year-one committed spend (subject to legal/finance review).

Action items for Neoterix:
- Please confirm billing/procurement contact for PO: (Tom is copied — will that be the right person?).
- Sign the MOU here: https://docusign.example/s/NEOTERIX-MOU
- Once signed, we'll provision the coupon code: NEO-45-200K and schedule a kickoff with Hannah to unblock the integration.

Hannah — can you reach out to Tom to schedule a 60-minute onboarding session this week and set weekly check-ins?

Asha — happy to hop on a call if Tom wants to walk through the remaining integration items. Thanks for moving quickly on the PO side — that helps accelerate transition to a paid pilot.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
